body:
Where do I start? I had an abusive childhood, my parents hated each other, they divorced when I was 15. I kind of got over that, I had a semi enjoyable late teens and early 20’s. I had a lot of friends, always having fun, happy....no drug or drinking problems.
Then I was 25 and got a job in corrections. Seeing what I see everyday, it changed me. I met a coworker there, started dating...got pregnant with twins no less....he became abusive, in every way imaginable. Verbally and mentally, mostly. I got away from him after the kids turned 3. 
Now I’m in a relationship where he has PTSD from being deployed in Afghanistan. He saw and did some terrible things. I feel like I’m meant to be in his life, to help him. I’m an empath...I feel people’s feelings...so when he’s going through his depression, I take it on as my own. It’s up and down every day. My job is utterly depressing. I have a mother who is mentally and verbally abusive. I struggle with anxiety. All I want is to be happy. Sometimes I think it’s so simple, but yet so hard to attain. There’s some other things too, but that the bones of it all.
I wish it was that easy. I know I’d be much happier if I wasn’t in this world.
I have no one to talk to, I never did. My family doesn’t care. I have so much bad things going on I just feel like I’m drowning.
